questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es la función socket() en Python?
questions.question_en: What is the socket() function in Python?
options_es: Crear un archivo temporal en el sistema
options_en: Create a temporary file on the system
Send data to the remote server
questions.explanation_es: socket.socket() crea un nuevo socket. Sintaxis: socket.socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM) para TCP IPv4. AF_INET es dirección IPv4, SOCK_STREAM es TCP.
questions.explanation_en: socket.socket() creates a new socket. Syntax: socket.socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM) for TCP IPv4. AF_INET is IPv4 address family, SOCK_STREAM is TCP.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué método se usa para conectar a un servidor TCP?
questions.question_en: Which method is used to connect to a TCP server?
questions.explanation_es: connect() establece conexión con un servidor remoto. Sintaxis: socket.connect((host, puerto)). send() envía datos, bind() vincula a un puerto local, listen() espera conexiones.
questions.explanation_en: connect() establishes connection with a remote server. Syntax: socket.connect((host, port)). send() sends data, bind() binds to local port, listen() waits for connections.

questions.question_es:
Crea un socket TCP e imprime su tipo de familia de direcciones.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
print(s.family)
```
questions.question_en:
Create a TCP socket and print its address family type.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
print(s.family)
```
questions.explanation_es: En Python 3.12+, s.family imprime el valor entero del enum: 2 (AF_INET = IPv4). El atributo .family almacena el tipo de dirección del socket.
questions.explanation_en: In Python 3.12+, s.family prints the integer value of the enum: 2 (AF_INET = IPv4). The .family attribute stores the socket address type.

questions.question_es: TCP garantiza la entrega ordenada de datos.
questions.question_en: TCP guarantees ordered delivery of data.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, TCP es confiable y garantiza orden. Los datos llegan en el orden enviado. UDP no lo garantiza.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, TCP is reliable and guarantees order. Data arrives in the order sent. UDP does not guarantee this.

questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es el máximo número de conexiones pendientes (backlog) en listen()?
questions.question_en: What is the maximum number of pending connections (backlog) in listen()?
questions.explanation_es: listen(backlog) especifica el número máximo de conexiones pendientes. El SO puede limitar este valor. Típicamente entre 1-128 según la plataforma.
questions.explanation_en: listen(backlog) specifies the maximum number of pending connections. The OS may limit this value. Typically 1-128 depending on platform.

questions.question_es:
Imprime el tipo de socket (SOCK_STREAM para TCP).

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
print(s.type)
```
questions.question_en:
Print the socket type (SOCK_STREAM for TCP).

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
print(s.type)
```
questions.explanation_es: En Python 3.12+, s.type imprime el valor entero del enum: 1 (SOCK_STREAM = TCP). El atributo .type almacena el tipo de socket.
questions.explanation_en: In Python 3.12+, s.type prints the integer value of the enum: 1 (SOCK_STREAM = TCP). The .type attribute stores the socket type.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué método recibe datos de un socket?
questions.question_en: Which method receives data from a socket?
questions.explanation_es: recv(bufsize) recibe datos. Retorna una cadena de bytes. send() envía datos. El argumento bufsize especifica el máximo número de bytes a recibir.
questions.explanation_en: recv(bufsize) receives data. Returns a bytes string. send() sends data. The bufsize argument specifies the max bytes to receive.

questions.question_es: close() cierra un socket.
questions.question_en: close() closes a socket.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, socket.close() cierra la conexión y libera recursos. Es buena práctica usar context managers (with) para cerrar automáticamente.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, socket.close() closes the connection and releases resources. It is good practice to use context managers (with) to close automatically.

questions.question_es:
Crea un socket y ciérralo, luego imprime 'cerrado'.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.close()
print('cerrado')
```
questions.question_en:
Create a socket and close it, then print 'closed'.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.close()
print('closed')
```
questions.explanation_es: close() cierra el socket sin error si ya está cerrado. Python se reinicia el contexto para cada prueba.
questions.explanation_en: close() closes the socket without error if already closed. Python resets context for each test.

questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre send() y sendall()?
questions.question_en: What is the difference between send() and sendall()?
options_es: send() puede enviar solo parte de los datos, sendall() garantiza todo
No hay diferencia real entre ambos métodos ya que internamente usan la misma llamada al sistema
sendall() es más lento porque añade una capa de cifrado adicional a cada fragmento enviado
options_en: send() may send only part of data, sendall() guarantees all
There is no real difference between both methods since they internally use the same system call
sendall() is slower because it adds an extra encryption layer to each fragment sent
questions.explanation_es: send() retorna cuántos bytes envió (puede ser menor que el buffer). sendall() continúa hasta enviar todo o fallar. sendall() es más seguro para aplicaciones.
questions.explanation_en: send() returns how many bytes were sent (may be less than buffer). sendall() continues until all sent or fails. sendall() is safer for applications.

questions.question_es:
Crea un socket TCP y verifica si es bloqueante.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
print(s.getblocking())
```
questions.question_en:
Create a TCP socket and check if it is blocking.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
print(s.getblocking())
```
questions.explanation_es: Por defecto, los sockets TCP son bloqueantes (True). getblocking() retorna True si es bloqueante, False si no.
questions.explanation_en: By default, TCP sockets are blocking (True). getblocking() returns True if blocking, False otherwise.

questions.question_es: Un socket bloqueante suspende el programa si no hay datos disponibles.
questions.question_en: A blocking socket suspends the program if no data is available.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, en modo bloqueante recv() espera hasta recibir datos. En no-bloqueante lanzaría una excepción. Usar select() o threading para no bloquear.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, in blocking mode recv() waits until data arrives. In non-blocking mode it would raise an exception. Use select() or threading to avoid blocking.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué es el timeout de un socket?
questions.question_en: What is socket timeout?
options_es: El tiempo de vida total de la conexión desde que se abre hasta que se cierra
El máximo tiempo para que complete una operación
La latencia del servidor medida en milisegundos durante la fase de autenticación
options_en: The total lifetime of the connection from when it opens until it closes
Max time for an operation to complete
The server latency measured in milliseconds during the authentication phase
questions.explanation_es: El timeout define cuánto esperar antes de abandonar una operación (recv, connect, etc.). Se establece con settimeout(segundos). Evita bloqueos indefinidos.
questions.explanation_en: Timeout defines how long to wait before abandoning an operation (recv, connect, etc.). Set with settimeout(seconds). Prevents indefinite blocking.

questions.question_es:
Obtén el nombre del host local.

```python
import socket
print(socket.gethostbyname('localhost'))
```
questions.question_en:
Get the local hostname.

```python
import socket
print(socket.gethostbyname('localhost'))
```
questions.explanation_es: socket.gethostbyname('localhost') traduce el nombre de host 'localhost' a su dirección IP: 127.0.0.1 (loopback IPv4).
questions.explanation_en: socket.gethostbyname('localhost') translates the hostname 'localhost' to its IP address: 127.0.0.1 (IPv4 loopback).

questions.question_es: ¿Qué retorna accept() en un servidor?
questions.question_en: What does accept() return on a server?
options_es: Un entero que representa el descriptor del archivo del socket
Un booleano indicando si la conexión fue aceptada correctamente
options_en: An integer representing the socket's file descriptor
A boolean indicating whether the connection was accepted correctly
questions.explanation_es: accept() retorna una tupla (socket_conexión, dirección_remota). El socket es la nueva conexión, la dirección es (host, puerto) del cliente.
questions.explanation_en: accept() returns a tuple (connection_socket, remote_address). The socket is the new connection, address is (host, port) of client.

questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es el tipo de socket para UDP?
questions.question_en: Which socket type is for UDP?
questions.explanation_es: socket.SOCK_DGRAM es para UDP (datagramas, sin conexión). SOCK_STREAM es para TCP (stream, orientado a conexión).
questions.explanation_en: socket.SOCK_DGRAM is for UDP (datagrams, connectionless). SOCK_STREAM is for TCP (stream, connection-oriented).

questions.question_es: UDP requiere establecer una conexión antes de enviar datos.
questions.question_en: UDP requires establishing a connection before sending data.
questions.explanation_es: No, UDP es sin conexión. Puedes enviar datos directamente con sendto(). TCP requiere connect() primero.
questions.explanation_en: No, UDP is connectionless. You can send data directly with sendto(). TCP requires connect() first.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué método se usa para enviar datos en UDP?
questions.question_en: Which method is used to send data in UDP?
questions.explanation_es: sendto(datos, (host, puerto)) envía un datagrama. send() es para TCP. recvfrom() recibe en UDP (retorna datos y dirección).
questions.explanation_en: sendto(data, (host, port)) sends a datagram. send() is for TCP. recvfrom() receives in UDP (returns data and address).

questions.question_es:
Crea un socket UDP e imprime su tipo.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
print(s.type)
```
questions.question_en:
Create a UDP socket and print its type.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
print(s.type)
```
questions.explanation_es: En Python 3.12+, s.type para UDP imprime el valor entero del enum: 2 (SOCK_DGRAM = UDP). El valor 2 identifica sockets de datagramas.
questions.explanation_en: In Python 3.12+, s.type for UDP prints the integer value of the enum: 2 (SOCK_DGRAM = UDP). The value 2 identifies datagram sockets.

questions.question_es: UDP es ideal para aplicaciones que requieren velocidad pero pueden tolerar pérdida de paquetes.
questions.question_en: UDP is ideal for applications that require speed but can tolerate packet loss.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, UDP prioriza velocidad sobre confiabilidad. Videoconferencia, streaming, juegos usan UDP. Correo, transfer de archivos usan TCP.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, UDP prioritizes speed over reliability. Video conferencing, streaming, games use UDP. Email, file transfer use TCP.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué retorna recvfrom()?
questions.question_en: What does recvfrom() return?
options_es: Solo datos en formato de cadena de texto
Solo la dirección IP del remitente original
options_en: Only data in text string format
Only the IP address of the original sender
questions.explanation_es: recvfrom(bufsize) retorna una tupla (datos, (host, puerto)). Permite conocer quién envió el datagrama.
questions.explanation_en: recvfrom(bufsize) returns a tuple (data, (host, port)). It allows knowing who sent the datagram.

questions.question_es:
Crea un socket UDP, vincula al puerto 9999 y ciérralo, luego imprime 'listo'.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
s.bind(('localhost', 9999))
s.close()
print('listo')
```
questions.question_en:
Create a UDP socket, bind to port 9999 and close it, then print 'ready'.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
s.bind(('localhost', 9999))
s.close()
print('ready')
```
questions.explanation_es: bind() vincula el socket a una dirección local. Es necesario antes de recvfrom() en UDP.
questions.explanation_en: bind() binds the socket to a local address. It is required before recvfrom() in UDP.

questions.question_es: Los datagramas UDP están limitados a 65535 bytes.
questions.question_en: UDP datagrams are limited to 65535 bytes.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, UDP tiene límite de 65535 bytes (2^16 - 1) debido al tamaño del campo de longitud. TCP no tiene límite teórico.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, UDP has a limit of 65535 bytes (2^16 - 1) due to the length field size. TCP has no theoretical limit.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué es broadcast en UDP?
questions.question_en: What is broadcast in UDP?
options_es: Enviar a un grupo de hosts
Enviar a todos los hosts en la red local
options_en: Send to a group of hosts
Send to all hosts on the local network
questions.explanation_es: Broadcast envía a la dirección de broadcast (última dirección de la red, ej. 192.168.1.255). Todos los hosts en la red reciben el datagrama.
questions.explanation_en: Broadcast sends to the broadcast address (last address of network, e.g., 192.168.1.255). All hosts on the network receive the datagram.

questions.question_es: Multicast es similar a broadcast pero solo ciertos hosts reciben.
questions.question_en: Multicast is similar to broadcast but only certain hosts receive.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, multicast es un tipo de emisión selectiva. Los hosts se unen a un grupo multicast (rango 224.0.0.0/4) solo reciben los datagramas.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, multicast is selective broadcast. Hosts join a multicast group (range 224.0.0.0/4) and only they receive the datagrams.

questions.question_es:
Envía datos UDP a 127.0.0.1:5000 y cierra el socket.

```python

s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
s.sendto(b'hola', ('127.0.0.1', 5000))
s.close()
print('enviado')
```
questions.question_en:
Send UDP data to 127.0.0.1:5000 and close the socket.

```python
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
s.sendto(b'hello', ('127.0.0.1', 5000))
s.close()
print('sent')
```
questions.explanation_es: sendto() envía un datagrama. No necesita connect(). Retorna el número de bytes enviados.
questions.explanation_en: sendto() sends a datagram. No need for connect(). Returns number of bytes sent.

questions.question_es: ¿UDP es mejor o peor que TCP en términos de latencia?
questions.question_en: Is UDP better or worse than TCP in terms of latency?
questions.explanation_es: UDP tiene menor latencia porque no requiere handshake ni control de flujo. TCP es más confiable pero con mayor overhead.
questions.explanation_en: UDP has lower latency because it does not require handshake or flow control. TCP is more reliable but with more overhead.

questions.question_es: En UDP, el emisor puede llamar connect() para asociar el socket a un destino.
questions.question_en: In UDP, the sender can call connect() to associate the socket with a destination.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, UDP permite llamar connect() (aunque no establece conexión real) para asociar un destino. Luego puede usar send() en lugar de sendto().
questions.explanation_en: Yes, UDP allows calling connect() (though not a real connection) to associate a destination. Then you can use send() instead of sendto().

questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es el puerto máximo que puede usar UDP?
questions.question_en: What is the maximum port UDP can use?
questions.explanation_es: El número máximo de puerto es 65535 (2^16 - 1). Los puertos 0-1023 son bien conocidos, 1024-49151 registrados, 49152-65535 dinámicos.
questions.explanation_en: The maximum port number is 65535 (2^16 - 1). Ports 0-1023 are well-known, 1024-49151 registered, 49152-65535 dynamic.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué es el módulo ipaddress de Python?
questions.question_en: What is Python's ipaddress module?
options_es: Controla las consultas DNS y permite modificar los registros de nombres de dominio
Proporciona clases para trabajar con direcciones IP
Cifra direcciones IP antes de enviarlas por la red para proteger la privacidad
options_en: Controls DNS queries and allows modifying domain name records
Provides classes to work with IP addresses
Encrypts IP addresses before sending them over the network to protect privacy
questions.explanation_es: ipaddress proporciona IPv4Address, IPv6Address, IPv4Network, IPv6Network. Permite manipular IPs, subnetting, validación, etc.
questions.explanation_en: ipaddress provides IPv4Address, IPv6Address, IPv4Network, IPv6Network. It allows manipulating IPs, subnetting, validation, etc.

questions.question_es:
Crea una dirección IP y imprime su valor.

```python
import ipaddress
ip = ipaddress.ip_address('192.168.1.1')

questions.explanation_es: ip_address() crea un objeto IPv4Address o IPv6Address según el formato.
questions.explanation_en: ip_address() creates an IPv4Address or IPv6Address object depending on the format.

questions.question_es: ipaddress valida direcciones IP.
questions.question_en: ipaddress validates IP addresses.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, ip_address() lanza ValueError si la cadena no es una IP válida. Permite validación robusta sin regex.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, ip_address() raises ValueError if the string is not a valid IP. Allows robust validation without regex.

questions.question_es:
Crea una red y obtén su dirección de broadcast.

```
questions.question_en:
Create a network and get its broadcast address.

```python
import ipaddress
net = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.1.0/24')
print(net.broadcast_address)
```
questions.explanation_es: broadcast_address retorna la última dirección de la red (todos los hosts = 1).
questions.explanation_en: broadcast_address returns the last address of the network (all hosts = 1).

questions.question_es:
Obtén la dirección de red de una red.

```python
import ipaddress
net = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.1.0/24')
print(net.network_address)
```
questions.question_en:
Get the network address of a network.

```python
import ipaddress
net = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.1.0/24')
print(net.network_address)
```
questions.explanation_es: `network_address` devuelve la primera dirección de la red, la que identifica al segmento completo y no se asigna a ningún host (actúa como "nombre" de la subred). Para `192.168.1.0/24`, esa dirección es la propia `192.168.1.0`, mientras que la última (`192.168.1.255`) sería la de broadcast.
questions.explanation_en: `network_address` returns the network's first address, the one that identifies the whole segment and is never assigned to a host (it acts as the subnet's "name"). For `192.168.1.0/24`, that address is `192.168.1.0` itself, while the last one (`192.168.1.255`) would be the broadcast address.

questions.question_es: is_private indica si una IP es privada.
questions.question_en: is_private indicates if an IP is private.
questions.explanation_es: Sí, is_private retorna True para rangos privados (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16). También hay is_loopback, is_reserved, is_multicast.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, is_private returns True for private ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16). There is also is_loopback, is_reserved, is_multicast.

questions.explanation_en: is_loopback returns True for loopback addresses (127.0.0.0/8 in IPv4).

questions.question_es: ¿Qué retorna subnets() en ipaddress?
questions.question_en: What does subnets() return in ipaddress?
options_es: Un generador de subredes más pequeñas
questions.explanation_es: subnets(new_prefix) genera subredes más pequeñas. Ejemplo: red /24 dividida en /25 subredes (dos mitades).
questions.explanation_en: subnets(new_prefix) generates smaller subnets. Example: /24 network split into /25 subnets (two halves).

questions.question_es:
Verifica si 192.168.1.50 está en la red 192.168.1.0/24.

```python
import ipaddress
ip = ipaddress.ip_address('192.168.1.50')
net = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.1.0/24')
print(ip in net)
```
questions.question_en:
Check if 192.168.1.50 is in the network 192.168.1.0/24.

```python
import ipaddress
ip = ipaddress.ip_address('192.168.1.50')
net = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.1.0/24')
print(ip in net)
```
questions.explanation_es: El objeto `IPv4Network` implementa el protocolo `__contains__` de Python, así que el operador `in` comprueba si una dirección cae dentro del rango de la red comparando sus bits de red, sin calcular a mano el primer y el último host. Como 192.168.1.50 está entre 192.168.1.1 y 192.168.1.254, el resultado es `True`.
questions.explanation_en: The `IPv4Network` object implements Python's `__contains__` protocol, so the `in` operator checks whether an address falls inside the network's range by comparing its network bits, without manually computing the first and last host. Since 192.168.1.50 lies between 192.168.1.1 and 192.168.1.254, the result is `True`.

questions.question_es: overlaps() comprueba si dos redes se superponen.

questions.explanation_es: Sí, overlaps() retorna True si las dos redes comparten direcciones. Útil para validar configuraciones de red.
questions.explanation_en: Yes, overlaps() returns True if the two networks share addresses. Useful for validating network configurations.

questions.explanation_en: prefixlen returns the number of network bits (/8 in this case).

questions.question_es: ¿Qué diferencia hay entre IPv4Address e IPv4Interface?
questions.question_en: What is the difference between IPv4Address and IPv4Interface?
options_es: Address es IP, Interface es IP+máscara
options_en: Address is IP, Interface is IP+mask
questions.explanation_es: IPv4Address es solo la dirección. IPv4Interface es dirección + máscara (CIDR). Útil para obtener dirección y red en una sola estructura.
questions.explanation_en: IPv4Address is just the address. IPv4Interface is address + mask (CIDR). Useful for getting address and network in one structure.

questions.explanation_en: ipaddress automatically detects IPv4 or IPv6 and returns the appropriate type.

questions.question_es: ¿Qué es subnet_of()?
questions.question_en: What is subnet_of()?
options_es: Calcula las subredes posibles y devuelve un listado de sus direcciones de red
Obtiene la máscara de subred y la convierte a notación decimal con puntos
Comprueba si una red es subred de otra
options_en: Calculates possible subnets and returns a list of their network addresses
Gets the subnet mask and converts it to dotted decimal notation

questions.question_es:
Sin tocar la red, este código lee una respuesta HTTP en bruto con `http.client`. ¿Qué imprime?

```python
import io
from http.client import HTTPResponse


class Socket:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self._data = data

    def makefile(self, mode):
        return io.BytesIO(self._data)


raw = b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
response = HTTPResponse(Socket(raw))
response.begin()
print(response.status)
```
questions.question_en:
Without touching the network, this code reads a raw HTTP response with `http.client`. What does it print?

```python
import io
from http.client import HTTPResponse


class Socket:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self._data = data

    def makefile(self, mode):
        return io.BytesIO(self._data)


raw = b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
response = HTTPResponse(Socket(raw))
response.begin()
print(response.status)
```
questions.explanation_es: `begin()` lee la línea de estado «HTTP/1.1 200 OK» y `response.status` devuelve el código como entero: 200. `response.reason` daría el texto, «OK». La versión anterior pedía `httpbin.org` en vivo: sin red (el navegador del alumno, la CI) imprimía «error».
questions.explanation_en: `begin()` reads the status line “HTTP/1.1 200 OK” and `response.status` returns the code as an integer: 200. `response.reason` would give the text, “OK”. The previous version fetched `httpbin.org` live: with no network (the learner's browser, CI) it printed “error”.
